* '''Original''' ([[Strike Planning (V)]]): the card image at official release (5 March 2023)<ref name="ht-53a6001">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/53a600169f2a3fd1b105ba01f85cef84edcd22bd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/strikeplanning.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/strikeplanning.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/53a600169f2a3fd1b105ba01f85cef84edcd22bd 53a6001] “Virtual Set 21 Preview Cards”, 5 March 2023.</ref> prints: “If an [A New Hope] objective on table, deploy on table. Twice per game, may ▲ Mon Mothma or any general. During your first turn, while Stolen Data Tapes at Dune Sea, [Set 1] Obi-Wan deploys -6 there. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-6e6f7f7">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/6e6f7f7 swccg-card-json commit 6e6f7f7] “Set 21 Preview and Errata” (5 March 2023) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the errata card image (29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata)<ref name="ht-efc26cd">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/strikeplanning.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/strikeplanning.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba efc26cd] “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”, 29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata.</ref> prints: “If Rebel Strike Team on table, deploy on table. Unless opponent’s [Endor] objective on table, opponent generates no Force at your Endor system. Twice per game, may ▲ an [Endor] or [Death Star II] leader. May ▼ [Death Star II] Falcon to Endor system. [Immune to Alter]”<ref name="cj-304ab4f">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/304ab4f swccg-card-json commit 304ab4f] “Set 24” (29 December 2024) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' The deploy condition “If an [A New Hope] objective on table” became “If Rebel Strike Team on table”; “Unless opponent’s [Endor] objective on table, opponent generates no Force at your Endor system.” was added; the twice-per-game ▲ (take into hand from Reserve Deck) changed from “Mon Mothma or any general” to “an [Endor] or [Death Star II] leader”; the first-turn [Set 1] Obi-Wan deploy −6 at Dune Sea was replaced by “May ▼ [Death Star II] Falcon to Endor system.” (▼ = deploy from Reserve Deck). The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
